ops.issue: lit_en inverts the meaning: 時間を違えないこと = 'not mistaking the time' (being punctual), and めったにない says that is rare. 'His failing to be on time rarely happens (he's hardly ever late)' says the opposite, contradicting jp, en, pt and both expl fields.

Extra negation flips the meaning: めったにない = 'raramente existe/acontece'. 'raramente não existe' means it almost always exists — the opposite of the sentence ('Bill is seldom on time') and of the correct expl_pt.

structure_explanation.en: A sentence with a double negation that can confuse: the general topic ビルは opens it; then the clause 時間を違えない ('not to get the time wrong', i.e. to be punctual) is nominalized by こと and marked by は; めったにない says that this 'thing' (being punctual) is rare. So, literally 'it is rare that Bill is punctual', i.e. he almost never arrives on time. The first ない is verbal negation (違える→違えない); the ない of めったにない is the adjective 'not exist'.

Logo, literalmente 'é raro que o Bill seja pontual', ou seja, ele quase nunca chega na hora. O primeiro ない é negação verbal (違える→違えない); o ない de めったにない é o adjetivo 'não existir'.

structure_explanation.en: パパ is a vocative ('Dad') at the start. after.jp: どんなベッドでもないよりはよい。

structure_explanation.en: The sentence uses the target どんな ('what kind of') modifying ベッド (bed) and, with でも, forms どんなベッドでも = 'any bed, whatever it may be'. Then comes ないよりはよい ('it's better than not having one', ない 'to not exist' + より 'than' + は + よい 'good'). It is the generalizing pattern どんな…でも, with a comparison よい … より ('better than').

Depois vem ないよりはよい ('é melhor do que não ter', ない 'não haver' + より 'do que' + は + よい 'bom'). É o padrão どんな…でも de generalização, com uma comparação よい … より ('melhor do que').

before.jp: どんなに彼をほめてもほめきれない。
before.kana: どんなにかれをほめてもほめきれない。

structure_explanation.en: The sentence combines どんなに〜ても ('no matter how...') with the compound verb ほめきれない. どんなに intensifies and ても gives the concessive sense 'even if / no matter how much.' The ending 〜きれない (from 〜きる, 'to do to the end,' in the negative) means 'to be unable to exhaust the action': no matter how much you praise, the praise never ends/suffices. Note that here it is どんなに〜ても, not the pattern どんなに〜ことか.
structure_explanation.pt-BR: A frase combina どんなに～ても ('por mais que...') com o verbo composto ほめきれない. どんなに intensifica e ても dá o sentido concessivo 'mesmo que / por mais que'. O fecho ～きれない (de ～きる, 'fazer até o fim', na negativa) significa 'não conseguir esgotar a ação': por mais que se elogie, o elogio nunca acaba/basta. Note que aqui é どんなに～ても, não o padrão どんなに～ことか.

structure_explanation.en: Here we have どんなに + [adjective in the ～く form + verb] + ても = 'however much / no matter how'. どんなに遅くなっても = 'however late it gets'. The ～ても is the て + も form with concessive value. The close 起こしてください = the polite request 'please wake me up'.

before.jp: どのようなスポーツをなさいますか。
before.kana: どのようなすぽーつをなさいますか。

structure_explanation.en: Here どのような ('what kind of / what sort of') is an adnominal interrogative word modifying スポーツ ('sport'); it contains the same よう of 〜のような (which is the focus/target), only in the fixed interrogative form どの+ような. The verb なさる is the respectful (sonkeigo) form of する ('to do/play'), conjugated as なさいます, and か at the end marks the question. Structure: adnominal interrogative + noun + を + polite verb + か.
structure_explanation.pt-BR: Aqui どのような ('que tipo de / como') é uma palavra interrogativa adnominal que modifica スポーツ ('esporte'); ela contém o mesmo よう de 〜のような (que é o foco/alvo), só que na forma interrogativa fixa どの+ような. O verbo なさる é a forma respeitosa (sonkeigo) de する ('fazer/praticar'), conjugado como なさいます, e か no final marca a pergunta. Estrutura: interrogativo adnominal + substantivo + を + verbo educado + か.
